source:
@@U00088@@
What is this vision that suddenly seizes my senses!
I feel the holy fire of youth
coursing through every vein and nerve!
What god was it wrote these symbols
that calm the storm of torment inside me;
that fill my wretched heart with joy;
that with some mysterious force
reveals the forces of Nature around me?
Am | a god?
I?
Oh, suddenly it’s all so clear, so clear!
I see in the pure lines of this symbol
all of Creative Nature at work.
I understand the philosopher for the first time.
“The spirit world is open, not barred.
Your mind is closed, your heart is dead!
Rise up, young man, and bathe your breast
in the rosy flush of dawn!”

@@U00089@@
(He contemplates the symbol.)

@@U00090@@
Ah!
How all things weave into a unity!
Each living and working in the other!
Heavenly forces ascending, descending,
passing golden vessels from hand to hand!
Flying on fragrant wings between heaven and earth
till all creation sounds with one grand harmony!
What a brilliant show!
Ah!
But only a show.
translation:
@@U00088@@
这突然抓住我感官的景象是什么！
我感受到青春的圣火
流遍每一根静脉和神经！
这些符号是哪个神写的
平复我内心痛苦的风暴；
让我可怜的心充满欢乐；
带着某种神秘的力量
揭示我周围自然的力量？
上午 |神？
我？
哦，突然一切都那么清晰，那么清晰！
我在这个符号的纯粹线条中看到
所有的创造性本质都在工作。
我第一次理解了哲学家。
“精神世界是开放的，而不是封闭的。
你的头脑是封闭的，你的心是死的！
站起来，年轻人，沐浴你的胸膛
在黎明的玫瑰色红晕中！”

@@U00089@@
（他凝视着这个符号。）

@@U00090@@
啊！
万物如何交织成一个整体！
各自生活、工作于对方！
天上的力量上升，下降，
金器从一只手传递到另一只手！
乘着芬芳的翅膀飞翔在天地间
直到所有的造物都发出和谐的声音！
多么精彩的表演啊！
啊!
但只是一场表演。
